string.text: Huh?
Hi stalker! Welcome to the Cordon!
Wow, a new face round here. Nice to meet you.
Hey buddy, keep an eye out for those army dudes, they're roaming about more and more.
Taking a break on the outskirts of the Zone? Me too.
Hello brother! Welcome to our neck of the woods!
Hey brother!
Nice to meet a brother in arms!
Got a question? I'm here to help.
Hey, what brings you all the way over here?
You chose a bad time to show up at the Garbage, brother.
Hey, buddy! If only you knew how tired I am of these bandit mugs...
Searching these piles of trash too are you? Good luck buddy.
Hiya! Got any loot to spare?
Watch out for zombies coming from the factory - there's a shitstorm of 'em out there!
Phew, man. You look so much like a zombie I nearly blew your head off right there.
Welcome to Yantar lake, where you can catch a hake. Ha-ha! You get it? It rhymes! Ha-ha!
Welcome to Yantar, brother.
You're on the right path, stalker - we could use your help around here.
How goes it?
Hello to you too. Got a question?
Look who we got here! The Garbage welcomes all except, well, garbage.
Hey-hey, nice to see you're alone with no tail.
Bugger off, punk!
Sup, man! You must be in some serious trouble to be comin' here.
Well, I'll be horn-swoggled! Where're you from, buddy? Sit-sit, let's have a chat.
Stick your good manners where the sun don't shine and cut to the chase! Whaddaya want?
What's up, bud? Whatcha doing in these here parts? C'mon, speak up now.
What up my man?
Yo, got a smoke?
How goes it?
Take it easy on the handshakes. Whatcha looking for?
Hey-hey, nice to see you're alone with no tail.
Hey yourself. Now come on over here and tell me something new.
Holy crap on a stick! A fresh face in the Zone! Mi casa su casa, amigo!
Hello, friend. I suggest you stay on your toes around here. Being attacked three-four times a night ain't as much fun as it sounds.
This ain't a great time to be here, stalker. We've got a real war on our hands.
Hey! Keep your eyes peeled, 'cause the beasts around here are real smart, drop your guard and you won't know what hit ya!
Be careful around here and stick to the main roads. One wrong move and some beast will have you for breakfast.
Hi Stalker. Welcome to Agroprom.
Hey, Stalker. If you are here to fight the Zone's spawns, then Duty is your ally.
Hey! Join Duty - the faction for real men.
Hello, friend. Always good to see a fellow stalker.
Wassup? Here's a big Ukrainian welcome for ya.
Hey bro! If you want to ask something, ask away.
...And what have I told you about... Sorry Stalker, thought you were one of my squad. Anyway, what do you need?
Welcome to the lands of the free stalkers!
If it's your first time in the Dark Valley, pay a visit to Freedom's base. That's where the fun is at, especially the arguments between the mechanic and Ashot.
Hi Stalker. Stop by the base, put your feet up, and have a good time.
Welcome to the Dark Valley. It isn't dark despite the name, and it's the safest place in the Zone, after the Cordon, of course.
Looking to join those who are truely free? You've come to the right place.
Yo, brother!
Welcome, friend!
Got a question for me, stalker?
Looking for advice?
Regards, friend.
What can I do for you?
Looking for a free life? Join Freedom, where all are equal.
Welcome to the Swamps!
Take my advice - watch out for marshes and monsters.
A new face around here!
Trust my advice, friend, and stick to the reeds.
If you want to get out of these swamps, find a guide first.
Nice to see you!
Greetings!
Hi!
Yes?
Are you looking for help?
Can I help you?
Looking for work? Stop by the bunker.
Do yourself a favor, and stay away from the factory.
I'd like to talk, but right now, I'm too busy.
You again? What's new this time?
A decisive hello to you, stalker.
Hello, young man!
Hello! What do you want?
You want to trade or get a job?
You're probably interested in information. I'll answer all your questions as best I can.
Can you tell me something?
Sure, what do you want to know?
Nevermind. Sorry for wasting your time.
Where are the local anomalies?
Pretty far and few between. Theres a big one north of the Rookie Village - you'll hear it before you see it, as your gieger will be off the charts!
They say thats theres one out East, near the old electric engine. But I couldn't find it.

Hell yeah, just about walked into one. I was heading along the road to the Garbage, north of the Old Farmstead, through the trees, avoiding the radiation, and just about walked into a feild of Whirligigs. Thank god for anomaly detectors.
Sorry, don't know any big anomaly clusters round here, but there are a few small ones though.
The Concentration Camp is one whole anomaly. I don't want to end up there - my balls will get fried. I do plan on having kids when I get out of the Zone, and get a life in the Big World.
The Swamp is one huge chemical anomaly, you can't miss it - look for the huge green clouds. It's like fog. Just don't breath that crap, it'll eat your lungs.

Theres a whole feild of Electros north of the Agroprom road, in a small valley. I tried looking in there, but my head felt all funny and sore after a few moments, so I left. Not worth the pain, I think.

Theres this valley - south of the swamp. It's got so many Gravitational anomalies in there, you couldn't throw a bolt in without hitting 10 of them. My artifact detector was sqealing like mad, but I couldn't get close enough. Oh well.
Ha! Nice one buddy. You can't take a piss without hitting an anomaly round here. Just stay away from Burners and Electro's, and you'll keep the family jewels intact.
This whole place is an anomaly. Look left, anomaly, look right, anomaly, look at your feet, boots being destroyed by an anomaly. You catch my drift?
There's this huge Vortex feild behind Uncle Yar's Hanger. You can hear it from there. So can your geiger. It's hot, but the rewards might just be worth it.
The whole south complex of Freedom base is a radiation trap, but the boys say they've seen some anomalies in there, so there might be some artifacts.
South of the Old Factory, to the east, there's supposed to be an anomaly feild, but I couldn't find the damn thing.
I dunno, but this cracks opened up in the ground, in the south of the Valley. Our scouts said it got pretty damn hot around their, like they were standing next to a volcano.
I heard someone once found a Kolobok out by the Tanks.
Why do you want to know about the local anomalies? They're not on the regular paths, so don't worry.
Sorry, wish I could help, but I'm not familar with the local anomalies I'm afraid.
Old Factory, the two story building. Plently of Electro anomalies there. But your head hurts like crazy there as well.
The swamp is full of chemical anomalies - and bloodsuckers. Watch out for those bastards.
There's a bunch of gravitational anomalies that block the road to the swamps. They come fairly far into Agroprom.
Yeah, theres this small feild, just North of Duty Base. Easy to spot, since the ground comes up in a claw like formation. A few graviational anomalies.
Theres one in the forest somewhere, I've been told. But I don't know where it is exactly.
Local anomalies. Ha! Agroproms covered in them, both clusters and single anomalies. Watch yourself.
I've got enough problems with the mutants, I don't need more with the anomalies. Now bugger off.
Yeah, the swamp, just outside the Bunker. You can't miss it.
I dunno, you could try looking in the factory to the north, provided you don't mind ending up as a Zombie.
Theres one field, right to the north of the factory, outside of it.
Try the factory, although I don't recommend it.
Trying to stay alive around here with all these zombies is hard enough, I haven't had the time to go anomaly hunting.
I saw a swamp glowing green at night, near the Military base, but I didn't look much closer.
Theres a bunch of Electro's up in the rocks, in the North Western parts around here
Sorry, avoiding the Military and those Monolith nutcases is my biggest concern. Don't have time to worry about anomalies.
Your joking right? Here we are in the middle of a warzone, and your asking where are the local anomalies? Have you lost it man?
Sorry, I can't tell you.
I'm looking for some myself. Clan business.
Haven't you figured it out yet? The whole of the swamps is the anomaly.
What? There's a war on and you want to go look at anomalies? I hope you fall in and die a cowards death!
